items.title: James "Sing" Miller Interview, 1971-01-17
items.q: we were talking about Dave Oxley when he carried him off in the ambulance

ctx.x: Yeah, you'll be back. Yeah, you'll be back.

Yeah, we were talking about Dave Oxley when he carried him off in the ambulance. I'll be back, I'll be back. Well, remember we were talking a little while ago about mentioning about Cap, and talking about all the different people, all the musicians who have died, and they've all been playing at Preservation Hall at one time or another. And—
One time somebody dies, somebody said they need a piano player up there. I said, you got two or three of them up there already, don't need me.

items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: Sing Miller was up here a couple weeks ago telling about the fish fries too

ctx.x: Everybody around the neighborhood, you know, would be out there listening at the band, and come in and buy us a fish, you know, buy us a home brewery.

Yeah, Sing Miller was up here a couple weeks ago telling about the fish fries too, and he used to play for them. And he imagined sometime, if they didn't have a piano player, they'd just use a phonograph too.
That's right, use the phonograph and the drummer. That's right.
